actionable_sentences: The API call to cancel registration must include the appointment_id parameter with value '90123456'.
The system shall process any cancellation request and return a status indicating whether the cancellation was successful.
lifted_nl: The API call to cancel registration must include the appointment_id parameter with value '90123456'.
The system shall process any cancellation request and return a status indicating whether the cancellation was successful.
After a cancellation is completed, no further modifications to the associated appointment may be made until a new appointment record is created.
operations.LABEL: FUNCTIONAL_SPEC
Precondition: The appointment_id '90123456' refers to an existing appointment in the system.
The appointment must be in a cancellable state (not already cancelled).
Postcondition: The appointment with ID '90123456' is marked as cancelled.
No further modifications to this appointment can be performed until a new appointment is created.
assumptions: The system supports cancellation operations for appointments.
The appointment_id '90123456' is a valid identifier in the system.
invariants: An appointment cannot be modified once its cancellation status is set to true.
A cancelled appointment remains in a cancelled state until a new appointment record replaces it.
